title: iRacing Mazda MX5 Okayama Guide 1:43.4 - MX5 Okayama Track Guide & Setup

corners.braking: Braking up to about 80%, nice trail off down second gear
corners.line: Turn-in to the right, apex at the blue clone marker, back on the gas at the apex
corners.exit: Straighten out and use the whole track
corners.mistakes: Don't stamp your foot down, be progressive

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: Little dab on the brakes, back on the gas at the apex in third
corners.exit: Use the 50 board, get back on the gas as soon as possible
corners.mistakes: Race to see who can get back on the gas first

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: full brake, down to first gear

corners.label: T10
corners.braking: Brake just below 8% at blue cone, drop to 2nd gear.
corners.line: Turn in, get right wheels on grass, mid-corner 100% throttle.
corners.exit: Get back on gas at apex, 100% throttle.
corners.mistakes: Avoid ABS, lift to change car balance.

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: Brake around 80% at 50 board, drop to 2nd gear.
corners.line: Turn in, lift to change balance, brake to 7%, get back on gas at apex.
corners.mistakes: Avoid ABS, use mud patch to change car balance.

corners.braking: Brake to 100%, down to first gear.
corners.line: Turn in, lift, back on gas at apex.
corners.exit: Head right, up to second gear.

corners.label: T7
corners.line: Use white line as entry, lift.
corners.exit: Get back on gas early at apex.

corners.label: T8
corners.line: Halfway between 50 board and marshal's hut.
corners.exit: Get back on gas at apex.

corners.label: T10
corners.braking: Brake just before the end of dark gray gravel, 60%

general_tips: Click on the link in the description to get the setup used in this guide
Try and brake under the absolute limit to preserve tires.
Be careful of sandy bits and gravel
